engine_sample.entry_note: Press and release Track8, Note, Sample in order. Require normal foreground Sample view0 before engine sound pads. Pressing Sample again while already there selects alternate stock view9.
engine_sample.sound_count: Read S from the admitted engine header byte46. A sound index is valid only when0<=index<S.
engine_sample.sound_layout: The engine controls records determine whether a choice page precedes the sound list. For logical position L=start+sound, page=L//16 and physical pad=16+(L%16). Never treat upper pads0..15 as engine sound selectors.
engine_sample.release: Every press must have its matched release; host test leases are a backstop, not a reason to omit release.

track_button_semantics.persistent_select: Use a short press, for example 150 ms, then verify the selected track in the UI snapshot.
track_button_semantics.long_press: The native history timer is 333 ms. A track press held through that callback restores the previous history/grid track and view on release.
track_button_semantics.pad_during_track_hold: A pad press marks the same momentary/restore path.
track_button_semantics.scope: Native button behavior; not an engine mute or solo command.

native_chromatic_note_keyboard.scope: Native Note-view chromatic keyboard at default octave 3. These are note pads, not Sample sound-selection pads. All pad IDs are zero based.
native_chromatic_note_keyboard.gaps: Null entries are deliberate chromatic keyboard gaps and do not request a low-pitched note.
